t: The Endosymbiosis of AI: From Soap Bubbles to Positronic Brains
s: This article contrasts ephemeral LLMs ('soap bubbles') with persistent ML, reframing AI alignment as human-AI diplomacy. It advocates local-first, anti-entropy solutions like Pipulate, unifying 'physics' to manage 'contextual entropy' and challenge 'embodiment snobbery'.
